hero.title: BBA / BBA (Hons.) Majoring in Business Psychology
hero.lead: ATLAS BBA (Hons.) in Business Psychology is built for future-ready leaders, who want more than a business degree they want to understand people, drive performance, and shape the human side of business success.

panes.label: Overview

text.strong: The BBA (Hons.) in Business Psychology at ATLAS ISME

text: is built for a new kind of business leader one who understands that people are the driving force behind every successful organization. This interdisciplinary program bridges psychology and business, helping you

text.strong: master the science of human behavior, motivation, and decision-making in corporate, entrepreneurial, and global contexts.

text: You’ll explore how emotions, cognition, and social dynamics influence leadership, marketing, strategy, and innovation and learn to apply these insights to build stronger teams, brands, and cultures.Through

text.strong: experiential learning, case studies, industry projects, and behavioral labs,

text: you’ll develop the ability to design people-centric strategies, optimize performance, and lead with empathy and evidence-based insight. You’ll graduate ready to shape workplaces where people and businesses thrive together.

semesters.text: Begin your journey into the science of human behavior in business. This semester helps you understand the fundamentals of psychology and decision-making while grounding you in analytical and management thinking.

courses.text: Understand how emotions, thoughts, and cognitive biases influence behavior and choices, shaping individual, organizational, and societal decision-making processes in business contexts.
Explore what drives consumer decisions, brand attachment, and loyalty, learning how psychology shapes marketing strategies and customer engagement across industries.
Learn how organizations function by exploring leadership styles, motivation theories, and strategies for fostering collaboration, innovation, and long-term performance.
Build analytical thinking through Excel, learning to organize, interpret, and visualize data for data-driven, accurate, and strategic business decisions.
Explore India’s timeless wisdom and philosophical thought that promote ethical leadership, mindfulness, and a balanced approach to organizational and personal growth.
Master the art of expressing ideas with confidence, clarity, and professionalism across written, verbal, and visual communication formats.
Allows students to explore an interdisciplinary subject aligned with their academic and professional interests. Encourages applied learning through domain-focused projects and skill-building.
Strengthen analytical reasoning and structured writing by learning to evaluate arguments, synthesize ideas, and communicate insights effectively and persuasively.
